rendering.architecture: Canvas 2D retained numeric state plus native HTML controls, readouts and tables; SVG for circuits and plots
rendering.why_canvas: Depth-sorted torus surface, velocity marks, complete finite fibres up to 2744 points, and live heat cells; direct rendering avoids thousands of DOM nodes.
rendering.typical_backing_store_budget_bytes: sum(canvas CSS width × CSS height × min(devicePixelRatio,2)^2 × 4), about 11 MB for three 600×400 canvases at DPR 2
rendering.three_dimensional_scope: Orthographic projection of a parametric torus; physical equations use the explicitly flat coordinate metric.
rendering.repaint: Per-control changes; resize observer; explicit user-triggered time animation capped near 22 fps; no automatic motion.

accessibility.labels: Every range/select control has a native label and output. Every canvas/SVG has a text alternative, visible numerical readouts, scientific caption and scope.
accessibility.pointer: Pointer capture with cleanup on release/cancellation; torus canvas touch-action pan-y preserves vertical page scrolling.
accessibility.keyboard: Arrow-key torus rotation and native range/select/button controls; yaw/tilt sliders supply a non-drag alternative.
accessibility.targets: Range controls and buttons are at least 44 CSS pixels high.
accessibility.motion: Initial state is static; animation requires an explicit button; backgrounding or enabling reduced motion stops it.
accessibility.color: Sign labels plus velocity arrows; selected fibre uses a ring and image uses a cross; scaling curves have labels/dash patterns and an exact numeric table.
accessibility.mobile: Single-column figures below 850 px; two-column controls and numerical metrics on small screens; heat history panels stack below 620 px.
accessibility.persistence: URL query encodes every control; copy-link fallback exposes address-bar state; popstate reloads the same numeric model.
accessibility.offline: Numerical models and assets are local. Failure to fetch the independent reference record leaves models running and supplies an explicit record-loading message.

representation_boundaries: Taylor–Green is an analytic 2D flat-torus solution, not a 3D singular solution.
Toral fibres are complete for k≤3 and use quotient representatives; no holomorphic elliptic-curve interpretation.
Two feature qubits are separate from the 256-dimensional diagonal position register.
The circuit is untrained and simulated on a classical CPU, without shots or a noise model.
Random translation is a CPTP heat channel, not full incompressible Navier–Stokes.
Scaling powers are an illustration; no upstream singular-solution simulation or new quantum advantage is asserted.
browser_visual_review: Delegated to root; this record does not claim browser rendering was independently inspected by this subtask.
